 Pittala Bhanu Prasad Updated on 30 Oct 2026, 01:58 PM IST 
 The Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC JE Tier 1 admit card 2026 online on October 30, 2026 on the official website, ssc.gov.in. According to the official notification, the SSC JE Tier 1 exam 2026 is scheduled to be conducted from November 2 to 6, 2026. Candidates can download their SSC JE Tier 1 admit card 2026 online using their login credentials. The commission issues the admit card only in online mode on the official website; no other mode, such as post/email, is used to issue the admit cards. 
 SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 link:  Click here 
 SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 Out: Download Paper 1 Hall Ticket
 Candidates can access the admit card link using their registration number, Date of birth/password. The applicants must thoroughly go through the SSC JE admit card online before downloading it. Candidates should carry a hard copy of their admit cards along with a valid photo ID to appear for the  SSC JE exam . The following article provides detailed information and the steps to download the admit card.

 Steps to download the SSC JE Tier 1 2026 admit card 
 Candidates must carry their SSC JE admit card 2026 along with a valid photo ID to appear for the examination. The SSC JE Tier 1 admit card can be downloaded from the official website using the candidate’s individual login credentials. The following steps are to be followed to download the admit card: 
 Visit the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in 
 Click on the ‘Admit Card’ section on the homepage 
 Select the ‘SSC JE Tier 1 2026 Admit Card’ link 
 Log in using the credentials 
 The admit card will be displayed on the screen 
 Download and print the admit card 
 SSC JE Tier 1 2026 Exam Day Instructions 
 The SSC JE Tier 1 admit card 2026, issued by the commission, includes important exam-day guidelines. Candidates must read all the instructions on the admit card carefully and follow them during the examination. The following are some key exam-day instructions: 
 Candidates must arrive at the exam centre at least an hour before the reporting time. 
 Candidates are not allowed to leave the examination centre until the end of the examination. 
 Candidates must carry a copy of the admit card along with a valid photo ID ( Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License ) and recent passport-size photographs. 
 Candidates are required to follow the dress code and av oid wearing electronics, jewelry, or other prohibited items, such as mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, notebooks, or calculators. 
 Any evidence of cheating or assistance to cheat will result in the immediate disqualification of the candidate. 
 Candidates are expected to comply with the rules and regulations of the examination centre and cooperate with the faculty.

 In case of discrepancies in the SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 
 Candidates must check the admit card for any discrepancies and immediately contact the commission if issues arise. The details in the SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card 2026 must be correct and must match the photo ID at the centre. The contact details of each regional office corresponding to the jurisdiction will be available on the official website. 
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: What details are printed on the SSC JE Tier 1 Admit Card? A: The SSC JE Tier 1 2026 Admit Card includes the following details:
 Candidate’s Name
 Roll Number/Registration Number
 Exam date
 Shift timing
 Q: Is biometric/Aadhaar authentication required at the center? A: Yes. Candidates must undergo Aadhaar-Based Authentication at the gate.
 Q: What documents should I bring to the exam center? A: Candidates must bring a printed copy of their admit card, a valid photo ID like an Aadhaar or PAN card, and recent passport-size photographs.
